_about: AUTHORED content for ui/walkthrough.html: narration, which recommendation to feature, and review findings. Every number and field about the featured recommendation (tier, score, confidence, citation, plan, trace) is read from the snapshot at render time -- never copy them here. Eval numbers are read from the files named in eval_results.

featured.headline: Right cell, wrong reason
featured.agent_claim: Cell 36 needs an import-path update (the plan's first step).
featured.finding_claim: The 1.6.4 release notes move no import path. The claim is not supported.
featured.finding_real: But that same release deprecates chat message history, and cell 36 teaches ChatMessageHistory -- the same class as the deprecated InMemoryChatMessageHistory. The cell does need updating. The agent's own curriculum search reached exactly that conclusion (step 3); the plan written from it led with an import-path change and never named the deprecated class.

pattern.headline: The pattern across the snapshot
pattern.claims_caption: import-path claims supported by the release notes
pattern.notebooks_caption: notebooks behind them needed work anyway
pattern.confidence_caption: confidence says the release is real -- not that the advice is right
pattern.takeaway: Every release was real. Verification held up; the plans overreached.

other_failures.name: Model-invented repo
other_failures.text: V7 blog post: the model looked up openai/openai, which does not exist, and the verifier scored a genuine post as fabricated (0.15). Fixed: only repos named in the signal can be marked missing.
other_failures.citation: 01_data/demo_snapshot.json -- "How V7 gives AI agents institutional memory"
other_failures.caption: Model invented a repo; a genuine post scored as fake

other_failures.name: Wrong repo accepted
other_failures.text: github_lookup("langchain") ranks microsoft/markitdown first by stars; the restored repo guard rejects it.
other_failures.caption: Most-starred repo taken as the right one

other_failures.name: Silent search failure
other_failures.text: Before: a spend-limit error made every curriculum search fail silently, and three trends got confident add_new_lesson recommendations. Now it is flagged, blocked, and shows as a red warning on the card.
other_failures.caption: A failed search read as “no coverage”

other_failures.name: Eval measuring the wrong thing
other_failures.text: The eval paired results with gold labels by position; after one merged cluster, every score was graded against the wrong label. Fixed, and every number re-scored.
other_failures.caption: Eval graded answers against the wrong labels

review.closing: Our confidence scores didn't catch these -- our evaluation did.
